The same format covers interviews, proofs, figures, and the contributions authors claim

addClaim(a, { id: "C7",
  statement: "Participants distrusted
              the tool's suggestions.",
  validators: [
    { id: "v_attest", kind: "attest",
      checks: "provenance",
      inputs: ["R2"] },
    { id: "v_inspect",
      kind: "llm_judge",
      gated_by: "v_attest",
      criteria: "The cited excerpts
        express distrust…",
      inputs: ["R2"] } ] });
  • R2 points at interview transcripts, with Cohen’s κ = 0.81 and an ethics block
  • Attest gates inspect: the excerpts’ provenance is checked before anyone weighs what they say
  • Exhibits link claims to a figure, table, proof, derivation, or listing
  • Contributions record the advances authors claim; a human judges their novelty
Whatever its kind, every claim resolves to evidence a reader can locate.
